buyer_added_terms.text: ेेतताा ाारराा जजोोड़ड़ गगईई बबडड कक ववशशेषेष शशतत

1. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 2. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses This is Development Tender 1. BNP, Dewas reserves the right to visit the manufacturing facility of the manufacturing firm. 2. This tender is for development of venders for “Silica for inks”, hence already developed firm s or firms who have already received orders for the item (with whatever results) should not be considered in such tenders. 3. Manufacturer’s Authorisation: a) In case if manufacturer has submitted the bid then the bids of its authorized dealer sh all be rejected. b) Wherever Authorised Distributors are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificat e with OEM mentioning details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phon e No. required to be furnished along with the bid. c) One manufacturer can participate through one authorized agent or one agent can parti cipate on behalf of one Principal Manufacturer only. Also if any bidder is quoting agains t MAF (Manufacturer Authorization Form) then against manufacturer shall comply to all eligibility criteria. 4. Payment Terms:- Payment will be done after receipt of satisfactory report from user department and on production of all required documents by the firm. Applicable deduction o f taxes/duties will be made as per the prevailing act/rules/provisions. The payment will be done through RTGS Only. Paying Authority: HOF, Bank Note Press Dewas The firm has to submit bank details along with invoice mentioning:- Beneficiary Name: Account Number: IFSC Code: Address and Branch Details:

5. Shelf Life : The bidders has to submit the undertaking that shelf life of the material shall be mi nimum 24 months from the date of supply of material at BNP Dewas. 6. Delivery schedule:- Pre-production Sample : The firm has to supply pre-production sample in quantit y of “2 Kg.” after placing of GeM contract. The firm on whom supply order will be placed will have to supply the material in max imum 2 installments after approval of the preproduction sample . -Total quantity (inclusive of Pre-Production sample quantity) to be supplied within 175 days from the date of placing of contract. Quantity excluding the preproduction sample to be supplied after approval of the preproduction sample. However the net ti meline for completion of the delivery of material shall be 175 days from the date of placement of contract. Note:- a. Purchaser’s sample: After issuance of GeM Contract, successful bidder may collect the purchaser’s sample from Bank Note Press, Dewas for guidance. The successful bi dder will have own responsibility to collect the sample from Bank Note Press, Dewas by submitting request letter along with their authorized representative. However it s hould not affect the delivery schedule of the material. b. The pre-production sample should be 2 Kg quantity of single lot having single ba tch no./lot no. Multiple pre-production samples will not be considered at a single tim e. c . In case of failure of the pre-production sample, further chances may be given if th e pre-production sample does not come up to the contract requirement. However thi s shall be done without rescheduling of delivery time. d . In case of failure of pre-production sample, firm shall submit pre-production sampl e again after communication of rejection of sample from BNP Dewas . However the n et timeline for submission of pre-production sample/ samples at BNP Dewas is up to the scheduled delivery period of the material. i.e 175 days from the date of issue of GeM contract. No further chances for submission of another pre- production sample will be given beyond the scheduled delivery period i.e 175 days from the date of i ssue of GeM contract.( Net Timeline ) e. All supplies including pre-production samples must be received at BNP along with Certificate of Analysis (COA) from suppliers’ end, failing which; the supplied lot/sampl e shall be rejected. 7. Anti-bribery Clause: By participating in this tender, the suppliers/Vendors/Contractors are deemed to have undertaken that they shall not give or take, any financial or non-financial bribe, to or from any one during the tender or during the execution of the contract thereafter and if they notice any such inc

ident happening, they shall report it to Vigilance. 8. ZED & LEAN Certification: Government of India has launched scheme for obtaining ZED & LEAN ce rtification to MSE vendors. Accordingly bidders are requested to obtain these certification to ensure mi nimum wastage in production process which shall ultimately result In cost cutting & improvement in ef ficiency. For further clarification & assistance bidders are requested to go through website of ZED & LEAN certifi cation scheme, links of which are as follows: ZED: https://zed.msme.gov.in/ LEAN: https://lean.msme.gov.in/ NOTE: These certification shall not have any impact on eligibility criteria for qualification in te nder. 9. Warranty clause: a. The supplier warrants that the goods supplied under the contract is new, unused, and incorpo rate all recent improvements in design and materials unless prescribed otherwise by SPMCIL i n the contract. The supplier further warrants that the goods supplied under the contract shall h ave no defect arising from design, materials (except when the design adopted and / or the mat erial used are as per SPMCIL’s specifications) or workmanship or from any act or omission of th e supplier, that may develop under normal use of the supplied goods under the conditions pre vailing in India. b. This warranty shall remain valid for Twenty Four months after the goods or any portion ther eof as the case may be, have been delivered to the final destination and installed and commis sioned at the final destination and accepted by SPMCIL in terms of the contract. c. In case of any claim arising out of this warranty, SPMCIL shall promptly notify the same in writ ing to the supplier. d. Upon receipt of such notice, the supplier shall, with all reasonable speed (or within the period, if specified in the SCC), replace the defective goods after providing their replacements and no claim, whatsoever shall lie on SPMCIL for such replaced goods thereafter. e. In the event of any replacement of any defective goods during the warranty period, the warra nty for the replaced goods shall be extended to a further period of Twenty Four months fro m the date such replaced goods starts functioning to the satisfaction of SPMCIL. f. If the supplier, having been notified, fails to replace the defect(s) within a reasonable period (o r within the period, if specified in the SCC), SPMCIL may proceed to take such remedial action( s) as deemed fit by SPMCIL, at the risk and expense of the supplier and without prejudice to ot her contractual rights and remedies, which SPMCIL may have against the supplier. 10. Liquidated Damages: Not Applicable. 11. GST Return: Supplier should file the GST returns for outward supplies in time. In case of any Input credit Loss to BNP by way of their failure to files GST returns in time, BNP reserves the right to withhold the payment of further s upplies till production of evidence of filling of returns.” 12. GIT & GCC: Bidders are requested to go through link provided below regarding GIT (General instructio ns to Tenderer) & GCC (General conditions of contract) and submit an undertaking that bidder has read & unconditionally accepted all the clauses of GIT & GCC. In case if there is any contradictory provision betwe en GeM GTC and SPMCIL GIT & GCC then provision given in GIT & GCC of SPMCIL shall prevail.

GIT: https://www.spmcil.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/GIT-3.0-1.pdf GCC: https://www.spmcil.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/GCC-3.0-1.pdf 13. Land Border Share Clause: Bidders should submit undertaking regarding Compliance of Res trictions under Rule 144 (xi) of GFR 2017 as per DOE Order (Public Procurement No.4) dated 23.02 .2023 (as amended from time to time) regarding restrictions on procurement from a bidder of a co untry which shares a land border with India. 14. Note for bidders : Along with all the necessary documents/ certificates required as per the t ender conditions, the bidder should furnish a brief write-up, backed with adequate data, explainin g his available capacity (both technical and financial), for manufacture and supply of the required goods/ equipment, within the specified time of completion, after meeting all their current commit ments. 15. Quantity Tolerance: The seller shall be allowed a tolerance of +/- 5% on the ordered quantity. This t olerance is to simplify logistical constraints and accounting of material. If seller supplies quantity beyond t olerance limit (except quantity procure through option clause) then such material shall not be accepted an d no payment shall be made for such supplies. Also if seller supplies less quantity than tolerance limit with in stipulated delivery period then it shall be consider as supply shortfall. Further it is to be noted that payment shall be made for quantity actually received and accepted by BNP D ewas. 16. Documents Checklist:- The participating bidder has to submit the documents as per following mentioned order:- 1. Sealed and signed bid document as an acceptance of all terms and conditions mentioned in the bid without any deviation. 2. Sealed and Signed technical specification of the tendered product (attached in the Bid Docume nt.) 3. Sealed and Signed Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS). 4. Sealed and Singed Technical Data Sheet (TDS). 5. Manufacturer authorization letter issued by their principal manufacturer. 6. Undertaking/Declaration certificate for Blacklisting : Neither we nor any of our affiliates or subsidiaries – including subcontractors or suppliers for any part of the contract – do not stand d eclared debarred by DoE, MoF, GoI; DEA, MoF, GoI; SPMCIL; procuring unit of SPMCIL for participati on in tenders. The information provided above is correct and true to the best of my knowledge and belief. 7. MSE Udyam Certificate: Valid Udyam certification, if bidders wants to avail purchase preference against MSE PP Policy. 8. Undertaking for compliance of land border sharing clause: Undertaking regarding of Land Border Sharing Clause To,
